description: This file contains unit tests for the TimeoutValueValidator class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers package. It primarily tests the validation logic for timeout duration strings, including handling nulls, invalid formats, negative durations, and proper immutability checks.

classes.name: TimeoutValueValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for TimeoutValueValidator ensuring correct validation behavior for timeout header values and immutability.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Runs once before all tests to initialize a valid duration string using DittoDuration parsing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Runs before each test to instantiate the TimeoutValueValidator under test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that TimeoutValueValidator class instances are immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that passing a null header definition to accept() throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Tests that passing a null value for a valid header definition throws DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: canValidateDittoDuration
methods.description: Checks that the validator recognizes DittoDuration as a valid type for validation.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Ensures that a valid DittoDuration string does not cause exceptions when accepted.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotDittoDuration
methods.description: Checks that non-DittoDuration Java types do not cause validation failures.

methods.name: acceptNonDittoDurationString
methods.description: Validates that an invalid duration string like 'true' raises TimeoutInvalidException.

methods.name: acceptDittoDurationStringWithNegativeAmount
methods.description: Checks that negative durations like '-15s' raise TimeoutInvalidException with correct message.

methods.name: acceptDittoDurationStringWithInvalidTimeUnit
methods.description: Validates that unsupported time units like '1h' throw TimeoutInvalidException.
